title: Aye bahen zainab
body:
Aye behen zainab - 2
Wada karo wada karo aye behen zainab - 2
Ahle haram ko kalse behen abbas bankar sambhalogi naa...
Wada karo....
1. Ahsaan mujper itna karo, mere sirhane baythi raho
Kya sochti ho mujse kaho meri wasiyat bhi sumti raho
<<MINI>>
Tum mujko rolo mere saamne kal se ye aasu chupaogi naa
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jab bekasi ke maahol per shaame garibaan chane lage
Nana ki ummat jab aye behen khayme hamare jalane lage
Jal jaaye masnad meri magar aabid ko mere bachaaogi naa
3. Nazdeek mere aao zara dekho na sunnle sakina kahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaaogi jab qayd khane me tum bichdegi tumse ye bacchi wahi
Zindaan me tum bandhe haath se kabre sakina banaaogi naa
4. Begor hoga mera badan khaake shifa hogi mera kafan
<<MINI>>
Dekho rona nahi chayn khona nahi tumko mil jaaye chadar ye hona nahi
Tum apni chadar pyaari behen khaake shifa ko banaaogi naa
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Apne hi haatho pe laaya tha mai lasha hasan ka teero bhara
Mayyat ki bhai se rote hue tumne nikale the teere jafa
Waise hi mere laashe se tum teero ko aaker nikalogi naa
6.aankho me uske kayi khwab hai tum jaanti ho wa hassaz hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo muntazir hai dehliz per usko judaai ka ehsaas hai
Zainab hamari majburiya sughra ko jaaker bataaogi naa
7. Ahsaan mujper itna karo, mere sirhane baythi raho
Kya sochti ho mujse kaho meri wasiyat bhi sunti raho
<<MINI>>
Tum mujko rolo mere saamne kal se ye aasu chupaogi naa
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Begor hoga mera badan khaake shifa hogi mera kafan
<<MINI>>
Dekho rona nahi chayn khona nahi tumko mil jaaye chadar ye hona nahi
Tum apni chadar pyaari behen khaake shifa ko banaaogi naa
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Sunkar wasiyat shabbir ki haaye takallum wo roti rahi
Armaan awaaze ibne ali ye kehte kehte thamsi gayi
Pyaaso ko pani pilaaogi naa farshe aza tum bichaogi naa
Aye behen zaynab - 4
